mentions.name: Airless 3D-Printed Scooter Tire/Wheel
mentions.description: This project develops an airless tire and wheel for an electric scooter, 3D printed by the builder. A first full PLA prototype has been produced, and small-scale TPU tests are underway to decide between multiple designs before finishing a working prototype.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started yesterday working on an airless 3d printed tire/wheel for my electric scooter, and got the first full PLA prototype. Currently waiting for small scale TPU tests to decide which of my designs to go with, and I expect to have a working prototype tomorrow or Tuesday
mentions.author: dgellow
